info.description:
The following groups of endpoints are stateful in the Sandbox: - [Capital Gains on Residential Property Disposals](#tag/Capital-Gains-on-Residential-Property-Disposals) - [Other Capital Gains and Disposals](#tag/Other-Capital-Gains-and-Disposals) # Send fraud prevention data HMRC monitors transactions to help protect your customers' confidential data from criminals and fraudsters.
! Warning You are required by law to submit header data for this API. This includes all associated APIs and endpoints.
[Check the data you need to send](/guides/fraud-prevention/). You can also use the [Test API](/api-documentation/docs/api/service/txm-fph-validator-api/1.0) during initial development and as part of your quality assurance checks. # Mapping APIs to Self Assessment tax return forms Some parameters in this API map to box numbers in one or more Self Assessment tax return forms. To learn more and to download this mapping information as a CSV file, go to [income-tax-mtd-changelog/mapping](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog?tab=readme-ov-file#mapping-apis-to-self-assessment-tax-return-forms) on GitHub. # Changelog You can find the changelog in the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/#readme) on GitHub. # Support * Direct reports of bugs or errors in Production or Sandbox code, or queries about HMRC business functionality (such as how a specific field is used by HMRC or why it is needed) to the [Software Development Support Team (SDST)](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/developer/support). * Send queries or feedback related to the design of the APIs (including recommended changes) using the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/issues) GitHub page. * Is this page not working properly? delete.description:
This endpoint allows the developer to delete user submitted Other Capital Gains and Disposals
with the exception of residential property, for a given NINO and tax year.

### Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                              |
|----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response with gains.                |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no disposals were found. |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful delete.                           |
| REQUEST_CANNOT_BE_FULFILLED      | Simulates the scenario where the request cannot be fulfilled for various reasons other than the ones triggering other errors. |

schema.title: Retrieve Other Capital Gains and Disposals Response
schema.description: Retrieve Other Capital Gains and Disposals Response

submittedOn.description: The date the disposals were submitted to the Report and pay Capital Gains Tax on UK property service. It is in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

disposals.description: An array of other Capital Gains disposals.

assetType.description: The type of asset being disposed of.

assetDescription.description: A description of the asset being disposed of. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

acquisitionDate.description: The date the asset was acquired in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`. For brokers' schedules where gains from several disposals are entered as one, this should be the date on which the first asset was acquired.

disposalDate.description: The date that the asset was disposed of in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`. For brokers' schedules where gains from several disposals are entered as one, this should be the date on which the last asset was disposed of.

disposalProceeds.description: The total proceeds from the disposal of the asset. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

allowableCosts.description: The total amount of allowable costs that can be deducted from the disposal proceeds. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

gain.description: The total gain from the disposal. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

loss.description: The total loss from the disposal. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

claimOrElectionCodes.description:
The claim, election or notice codes related to the disposal. Possible values are:\
`PRR` - Private Residence Relief where Letting Relief does not apply\
`LET` - Private Residence Relief where Letting Relief applies\
`GHO` - Gift Hold-Over Relief\
`ROR` - Rollover Relief\
`PRO` - Provisional Rollover Relief\
`ESH` - Employee Shares\
`NVC` - Negligible Value Claims\
`SIR` - Social Investment Tax Relief\
`OTH` - Other claims\
`BAD` - Business Asset Disposal Relief\
`INV` - Investors' Relief

gainAfterRelief.description: The total net gain after any reliefs have been applied. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossAfterRelief.description: The total net loss after any reliefs have been applied. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

rttTaxPaid.description: The total amount of tax paid through the Capital Gains Tax Real Time Transactions service for this disposal. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

nonStandardGains.description: One of these fields must be provided: carriedInterestGain, attributedGains or otherGains

carriedInterestGain.description: The total amount of all the carried interest gains. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carriedInterestRttTaxPaid.description: The total amount of tax paid through the Capital Gains Tax Real Time Transactions service for all of the carried interest gains. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

attributedGains.description: The total amount of all the attributed gains where personal losses cannot be set off. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

attributedGainsRttTaxPaid.description: The total amount of tax paid through the Capital Gains Tax Real Time Transactions service for all of the attributed interest gains. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherGains.description: The total amount of any other asset type gains not reported elsewhere for the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherGainsRttTaxPaid.description: The total amount of tax paid through the Capital Gains Tax Real Time Transactions service on any other asset-type gains. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

losses.description: Details Capital Gains Tax losses relating to other disposals and non-standard gains. One of these fields must be provided: broughtForwardLossesUsedInCurrentYear, setAgainstInYearGains, setAgainstInYearGeneralIncome or setAgainstEarlierYear

broughtForwardLossesUsedInCurrentYear.description: The total amount of brought forward losses used for the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

setAgainstInYearGains.description: The total amount of trading losses set against chargeable gains for the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

setAgainstInYearGeneralIncome.description: The total amount of losses set against general income for the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

setAgainstEarlierYear.description: The total amount of losses set against general income for the tax year previous to the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustments.description: The amount of included adjustments to reduce or increase the Capital Gains Tax payable. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

get.description:
This API provides the capability to retrieve the residential property disposals subject to capital gains tax for payment for property disposal (PPD) and non payment for property disposal (non-PPD). This includes: - User submitted residential property disposals - Disposals previously reported via the HMRC 'Report and Pay Capital Gains Tax on UK Property' - User submitted disposal overrides ### Test data Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment. | Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario | |-----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | N/A - DEFAULT

**?source=hmrc-held** | Requesting **hmrc-held** source simulates success response with HMRC held disposals. | | N/A - DEFAULT
**?source=latest** | Requesting **latest** source simulates success response with Latest disposals and overrides submitted. | | LOSS
**source=latest** | Requesting **latest** source with LOSS simulates success response with User provided disposals and overrides with losses. | | NOT_FOUND | Simulates the scenario where no data is found. | | STATEFUL | Performs a stateful retrieve.

Information and data held by HMRC is not available in the sandbox environment. Providing ‘source=hmrc-held’ will result in the expected HTTP 404 (matching resource not found) error being returned.

(not reported via the 'Report and pay Capital Gains Tax on UK property' service) 
for a given National Insurance number and tax year.

The disposal date must be within the specified tax year. The completion date must be within the specific tax year and
not in the future. If the specified tax year has not ended, the completion date must be between 7th March and 5th 
April.

The total amount of additional costs when the property was acquired (Acquisition Fees) or disposed of (Disposal Fees). It may include fees for surveyors, estate agents and solicitors. If the costs were shared, enter only the amount of that particular owner's share.

The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

prfAmount.description: The total amount of Private Residence Relief claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherReliefAmount.description:
The total amount of other reliefs claimed.

The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesFromThisYear.description:
The amount of Capital Gains Tax losses from other disposals in the current tax year that reduce the overall gain of this disposal.

The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesFromPreviousYear.description:
The amount of Capital Gains Tax losses from disposals in previous tax years that reduce the overall gain of this disposal.

The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

amountOfNetGain.description: The total amount of net gain from the disposals. Either gain or loss must be populated but not both. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

amountOfNetLoss.description: The total amount of net loss from the disposals. Either gain or loss must be populated but not both. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.
